prompt: Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Use Spectrum 1-8: page #FBF9F9, text #2D261F, accent #79861D, secondary surface #E7EFEB, text on accent #111111. Set headings in Bagnard and reading text in Aileron; characterful display serif with quiet supporting text. Composition: Full-width relevant image with heading overlay, visible next section, no text/media split hero. Use body 18px, heading 28px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 32px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
